title: Prior authorization missing
signals: procedure or service needs prior authorization, no authorization number on file, authorization expired or for a different service
fix: Check the payer's authorization list for this service, attach a valid authorization number, or hold the claim and request retro-authorization before submitting

title: Timely filing risk
signals: claim submitted late, many days after the date of service, close to or past the payer filing deadline
fix: Submit immediately and keep proof of the original submission date; if the deadline has passed, prepare evidence for a timely-filing exception

title: Diagnosis does not support procedure
signals: diagnosis code does not support medical necessity for the procedure code, coding mismatch
fix: Ask the coder to confirm the diagnosis codes against the clinical note and the payer's coverage policy before release

title: Missing or wrong modifier
signals: modifier missing on a procedure line, bilateral or distinct procedure not marked
fix: Add the correct modifier for the procedure line and re-run the claim scrubber

title: Possible duplicate claim
signals: same patient, same service date and same procedure already submitted, duplicate
fix: Search for the earlier claim; if it exists, send a corrected or replacement claim instead of a new one

title: Out-of-network provider
signals: rendering provider not in network for the member's plan, network status
fix: Verify the provider's network status for this plan and check whether an out-of-network exception or referral applies

title: Missing claim information
signals: required fields empty on the claim form, missing member ID, NPI or address, paper claim
fix: Fill the missing fields from the registration record and prefer electronic submission so the clearinghouse edits catch gaps
